findings: Rewritten 2026-10-28 as printed: the book's wording read from the page images (the OCR text garbles this scan), every displayed formula and derivation line as an equation block, worked examples as example blocks with the book's solution lines, lists, highlighted definitions and boxes as printed. Roman Urdu follows paragraph for paragraph in simple language.

The quoted definition of gravitational waves is a definition callout; the Einstein and Mavalvala picture boxes keep their printed captions as notes; the four types are level-3 headings as printed; the eccentricity list is a table as printed. Captions of the photographs drawn without text (BS Model; concentric spheres; tidal forces; two spacetime-curve pictures) are not reproduced in English. The print also has 'wrap' (warp) and 'Astrophysicts' (copied as printed; Roman Urdu explains).
Book error shown as printed and marked: 'Compact Binary Inspirational Gws' and 'inspirational' (PDF 184); Book correction box gives compact binary inspiral GWs.

Book error shown as printed and marked: the amplitude 'of the order of 10⁻²¹ to 10⁻²² metres' (PDF 186); Book correction box: the amplitude is a dimensionless strain of 10⁻²¹ to 10⁻²² (about 10⁻¹⁸ m change in LIGO's 4 km arms).
